title: Austin's First Auto Rules & City Payouts
summary:
*   **Automobile Safety Regulations:** Approved a new ordinance requiring licenses for all drivers of automobiles for hire, marking an early effort to regulate the growing use of motor vehicles.
*   **City Compensation for Damages:** Authorized payments totaling $200 to citizens for incidents caused by city infrastructure, including land overflowed by utility works and a horse injured in an unlighted open ditch.
*   **Downtown Redevelopment:** Granted permits to Scarbrough & Sons for significant renovations to their Congress Avenue store, including temporarily blocking the sidewalk and installing new alley access points.
*   **Compassionate Release:** Remitted a prisoner's $10 fine and ordered their release from custody due to a severe eye injury that risked permanent blindness if confinement continued.

July 27th 1915.

Re: Scarbrough & Sons
To block sidewalk

The Chair laid before the Council the following resolution :

Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas :

That a permit be and is hereby granted the Firm of Scarbrough & Sons to block the sidewalk
in front of their store on Congress Avenue in this City during the period of time required
to erect a new front to said building; and Be it further resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin : That this permit is temporary and revocable at any time in the
pleasure of the City Council .

The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew,
Haynes & Powell 4 Nays none.

Approved, E C Bartholomew, Mayor Pro tem

The Chair laid before the Council the following resolution :

Resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas :

That permission be and is hereby granted the firm of E M Scarbrough & Sons to place
area-ways in the rear of their store building on Congress Avenue in this City ,said
area-ways to extend not farther than three feet into the alley and to be protected by iron
or steel grill levelor not higher than two inches above alley ; to be substantially faced
,sufficient to hold the earth in proper place; and
Be it further resolved :

That the City of Austin shall not be held responsible for ant damage ,caused by or from
these area-ways.

The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew,
Haynes & Powell 4 Nays none,

Approved, E E Bartholomew, Mayor Pro tem .
